name: Ishimatsu Seishirou
source:
A mysterious tall man.
He has blond hair and blue eyes, but his face is clearly Japanese.
Always carries a Japanese sword on his waist, which makes him look like a samurai.
He is the guard dog of the Saiki group, but he doesn't talk a lot.
The truth is always a mystery.
